__how_to_use: Copy this file to settings.local.json. Every key below starts with __ , and keys starting with __ are ignored as comments -- so this file does NOTHING until you remove the __ prefix from the section you actually want. Keep only the keys THIS machine overrides; everything else keeps following the shared settings.json, so new settings still arrive with a git pull.

__triggers._focus_method: quiet = raise the target window without injecting input (default). alt = the legacy pyautogui.press('alt') hack, which is what makes Windows beep on a cue. none = never try to change focus.
__triggers._alt_fallback: true (default) = if quiet focus fails, try the legacy ALT hack rather than give up on the trigger. Set false to keep the machine silent, accepting that a trigger whose window cannot be focused is not delivered.
__triggers._require_focus: false (default) = send the simulated keystroke even when the target window could not be focused, as the code always did -- it may land in another window. true = skip it instead, and log the marker as not recorded.
